lines.en: I give Imani a call and somehow wind up going over to her place first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: 我打给 Imani,不知怎么地,一大早就去了她家。

lines.en: Is making a trek across town something I wanted to do as soon as I woke up? Absolutely not. But for some reason, I just have a hard time saying no to her.
lines.zh: 刚睡醒就想横穿城镇跑一趟?绝对不想。但不知为何,我就是很难对她说不。

lines.en: Maybe it's due to the fact that I'm well aware she's doing my job for me at this point and that I feel...indebted to her for that.
lines.zh: 也许是因为我很清楚,到了这一步,她是在替我做我的工作,而我为此感到……亏欠她。

lines.en: Or maybe it's because I just like being around her for some strange, borderline masochistic reason. I wouldn't put something like that past me at this point.
lines.zh: 又或者,是因为出于某种奇怪的、近乎受虐的理由,我就是喜欢待在她身边。到了这一步,这种事发生在我身上我丝毫不奇怪。

lines.en: I'm sure I have a tipping point when it comes to incessant teasing without any payoff but, if I'm able to survive Uta, I'm positive I can handle Imani.
lines.zh: 对于只有挑逗毫无回报的纠缠,我确信自己有个临界点。但如果我能从 Uta 手下活下来,我肯定也能应付 Imani。

lines.en: I also don't think Imani would have to make any phone calls before taking her pants off and, to me, that is a major plus.
lines.zh: 另外,我不认为 Imani 脱裤子之前还需要先打几个电话。对我来说,这是重大加分项。

lines.en: The two of us spend the morning sitting on her bed (Which is actually just a mattress on the floor) and talking about school (Which is really just her regurgitating gossip).
lines.zh: 我们俩的整个上午,都坐在她的床上(其实只是地板上的床垫)聊学校的事(其实只是她在反刍八卦)。

lines.en: Why she wants to be so involved in school drama, I have no clue. But she does feel like a teenager trapped in an adult's body at times, so I guess it makes sense.
lines.zh: 她为什么这么热衷于校园肥皂剧,我毫无头绪。但她有时确实像个被困在成人身体里的青少年,所以也算合理。

lines.en: I'm not about to tell her how to live her life. And, to be honest, she seems so focused most of the time that I doubt she'd even listen to me if I did.
lines.zh: 我也没打算教她怎么过日子。而且说实话,她大多数时候专注得很,就算我说了,她多半也不会听。

lines.en: Instead, I just let her do her thing...because I know that chances are, one day, I'm not going to have her around anymore...or at least not as much as I want.
lines.zh: 我只是任由她做她的事……因为我知道,八成有一天,她就不会在我身边了……或者至少,不会像我希望的那么多。

lines.en: Unless the world has something to say about it, I guess.
lines.zh: 除非这个世界有意见,我猜。

lines.en: I kind of hope it doesn't.

lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
